Three things differ from Chrome, and all three are hard requirements:
1. No `key`. It is a Chrome mechanism; Firefox identifies an add-on by
browser_specific_settings.gecko.id instead. The build strips it.
non-persistent event page; it has no service-worker background. `type:
module` still applies, so background.js keeps its imports.
